name: graviss
author: lumine-code
description: Explore finite element models in an interactive engineering viewport.
backgroundTips: You can fit the active FEM model to its viewport with {{ 'graviss:fit-view' | keystroke }}
You can narrow a FEM model to the elements you are interested in with {{ 'graviss:toggle-filter-panel' | keystroke }}
You can animate a load case over the FEM model with {{ 'graviss:toggle-results-panel' | keystroke }}

orbitAroundPointer.title: Orbit Around the Pointer
orbitAroundPointer.description: Pin the orbit to the front element under the pointer when a rotation starts, instead of turning around the camera target. A rotation started over empty space still turns around the target.

zoomTowardPointer.title: Zoom Toward the Pointer
zoomTowardPointer.description: Move the wheel's zoom along the ray under the pointer, so whatever it is over stays where it is, instead of zooming at the middle of the viewport.

smoothZoom.title: Smooth Zoom
smoothZoom.description: Settle onto what a wheel notch asks for over a few frames instead of arriving in one step — a depth in perspective, a framing in orthographic. Notches turned in quick succession compound rather than queue.

showOrbitPivot.title: Show the Orbit Pivot
showOrbitPivot.description: Mark the pinned point for as long as a rotation is being dragged. A press that never moved is a click and marks nothing, and the mark never reaches an exported image.

navigation.adapter.description: Lists and activates named Graviss graphics in navigation-panel.
